definitions.W1: Semantic answer selected on the original first-presentation Baseline.
definitions.W2: Semantic answer selected by a fresh Baseline under the remapped second presentation.
definitions.effect: Lesioned minus natural within the same condition and exact four-question cohort.
definitions.condition_specific_difference: Evaluation lesion effect minus Matched-Neutral lesion effect.
definitions.gla_write: Only the action-ending period's GLA write is removed; accumulated pre-period memory is preserved.
definitions.attention_read: Only later ordinary-attention reads from the action-ending period are blocked.
